response.sql: WITH ev AS (SELECT link_to_event AS event_id, AVG(CAST(spent AS REAL) / amount) AS ratio FROM budget WHERE link_to_event IS NOT NULL GROUP BY link_to_event) SELECT event_id, ratio AS spend_ratio, ratio / (SELECT AVG(ratio) FROM ev) AS relative_ratio FROM ev ORDER BY relative_ratio DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
